annotation.title_clean: ISO/AWI 25922 Ships and marine technology — Method for defining and allocating capabilities and responsibilities between maritime autonomous surface ships and their remote operators
annotation.title_en: ISO/AWI 25922 Ships and marine technology — Method for defining and allocating capabilities and responsibilities between maritime autonomous surface ships and their remote operators
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO/AWI 25922, a proposed standard in preparation (registered November 2025) specifying a method to describe and allocate capabilities and responsibilities between maritime autonomous surface ships and their remote human operators, including takeover alerting and worst-case response times.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies a method for describing capabilities and responsibilities of a MASS and its human operators
Assumes deterministic automation trusted to control ship functions under specified constraints
Operators must be alerted early enough to regain situational awareness
Operator organisation must provide deterministic worst-case response time
Aims at common understanding among owners, designers, authorities and class societies
